background: without opening the window: the icon next to the clock reopens it (start with Windows, node/autostart.py)
network: turns the network on whatever the setting
no_discovery: no UDP announcements (adding by address only)
internet: starts the aiodos-net companion (Internet) whatever the setting
internet_local: companion in local test mode: no relay, no directory, no router (tests)
internet_relay_only: companion tested through this relay only, never directly, without directory or router (tests)
slots: simultaneous units on this node, e.g. “embed=1,gpu=0”
no_migrate: do not import the v1 data (tests)
data_dir: data folder (several nodes on the same machine)
ui_file: writes the interface address, token included, to this file readable by you only, deleted on exit (Android app)
node_failed: The AIODOS node could not start (see data/logs).
start_cancelled: Start abandoned: the window was closed.
already_open: AIODOS is already open on this machine.
